recordingZoom.title: Recording zoom
recordingZoom.description: Hold your shortcut for a fixed target, or tap to toggle a zoom that follows the cursor.
recordingZoom.locked: Hold to lock the target. Tap to follow the cursor; tap again to zoom out. Both kinds of zoom can be edited or removed later.
recordingZoom.exclusion: The target outline is a separate window, excluded by native macOS capture and supported Windows capture. If exclusion is unavailable, the outline stays hidden and zoom markers still work.
recordingZoom.keyPassThrough: The shortcut is observed, not blocked: the focused app still receives the key. Use a modifier combination to avoid typing letters into the app you are recording.
recordingZoom.invalidSettings: Could not save the shortcut. Try again.
recordingZoom.recordingActive: Stop recording before changing this shortcut.
recordingZoom.hookUnavailable: Global keyboard input is unavailable. On Mac, grant Accessibility and Input Monitoring permissions, then restart.
recordingZoom.outlineHidden: The outline is hidden for this capture backend to keep it out of your recording.
recordingZoom.infoHold: Hold {{shortcut}}: the box stays fixed where you first pressed the key. Release to zoom back out and hide the box.
recordingZoom.infoTap: Tap {{shortcut}} briefly: zoom in and follow the cursor. The box moves with the cursor. Tap {{shortcut}} again to zoom back out and hide the box.
recordingZoom.infoCapture: The box is a guide only and is excluded from the recording. If safe exclusion is unavailable, the box stays hidden; the zoom still works.
recordingZoom.infoEdit: Zooms stay editable: change their timing, amount or focus, or delete them in the editor. Pausing or stopping ends the active zoom.
